article.hook: You know the moment when your finger hits send before your brain finishes the sentence? Mars moving through Aries hands you that impulse on a silver platter. It’s the push to start the fight or sprint the race before anyone else thinks to move.
article.lived: For the next six weeks, decisions snap into place like a shutter click. You don’t wait for permission or second opinions; you claim the spot, order the coffee, or launch the idea with no backtrack. Calendars cram with new projects, messages go out half-written, and people try to keep up with a pace that barely pauses between breaths.
article.turn: That rush turns sharp when the fight begins before you know what’s at stake. You cut someone off, slam the door, or burn the bridge because you never asked why you needed to win. Boldness without patience is just noise - action without cause is just wasted energy.
moves: Send the email that’s been waiting in drafts but add one question before hitting send.
Clear one thing off your calendar to make space for what demands your full attention.
Say no once this week without explaining yourself.
